Defines an Alembic migration to convert string content kinds to an ENUM type in the database.

# Purpose
This code is a database migration script using Alembic, a database migration tool for SQLAlchemy. The script defines an upgrade and a downgrade function to manage changes to the database schema. The [`upgrade`](<#upgrade>) function creates a new PostgreSQL ENUM type named `contentkind` with a set of predefined string values representing different kinds of content. It then alters the `content_kind` column in the `derived_contents` table to use this new ENUM type, ensuring that the column values conform to the specified ENUM values.

The [`downgrade`](<#downgrade>) function reverses these changes. It alters the `content_kind` column back to the `TEXT` type, allowing any string value, and then drops the `contentkind` ENUM type from the database. This script is part of a version-controlled database schema, allowing developers to apply or revert schema changes in a controlled manner. The revision identifiers `revision` and `down_revision` are used by Alembic to track the order of migrations.
